name: SEO
summary: Technical, on-page and local SEO that gets you found for searches that lead to enquiries.
answer: SEO (search engine optimisation) is improving your website so it appears higher in Google for the searches your customers make. HTH handles technical SEO, on-page content and local SEO, including Google Business Profile, and measures success by enquiries from organic search rather than rankings alone. It's for businesses that want a steady flow of leads without paying for every click.
whoFor: Local businesses that want to appear in the Google map pack
Service businesses relying too heavily on paid ads
Sites that lost traffic after a redesign or Google update
Businesses expanding into new cities or countries

problem.heading: Customers search for what you do and find your competitors.
problem.body: Your site has technical issues Google can see and you can't, your service pages are thin, and your Google Business Profile hasn't been touched in a year. Meanwhile competitors with worse service rank above you.

deliverables.title: Technical audit and fixes
deliverables.detail: Crawl, indexing, speed, structured data and site architecture issues found and fixed.

deliverables.title: Keyword and page plan
deliverables.detail: The searches that lead to enquiries, mapped to the pages that should rank for them.

deliverables.title: On-page optimisation
deliverables.detail: Titles, headings, content and internal links improved on your key pages.

deliverables.title: Local SEO
deliverables.detail: Google Business Profile, citations, reviews and location pages for each area you serve.

deliverables.title: Content
deliverables.detail: New service and location pages, and articles that answer real customer questions.

deliverables.title: Monthly reporting
deliverables.detail: Rankings, traffic and, most importantly, enquiries from organic search.

process.title: Audit
process.detail: Technical, content and competitor audit, with a prioritised fix list.

process.title: Fix
process.detail: We fix technical issues first, because they hold everything else back.

process.title: Build
process.detail: On-page improvements, local SEO and new content, month by month.

process.title: Report
process.detail: A monthly report and call focused on leads, not vanity metrics.

timeline: Technical fixes in the first month. Meaningful ranking gains usually take 3 to 6 months.

faqs.question: How long until we see results?
faqs.answer: Technical fixes can show results within weeks. Competitive rankings usually take three to six months of consistent work. We report progress monthly so you can see the direction early.

faqs.question: Do you guarantee first place on Google?
faqs.answer: No, and be wary of anyone who does. We commit to the work, the reporting and a clear plan.

faqs.question: Do you build backlinks?
faqs.answer: We focus on earning links through useful content, digital PR and local citations. We don't buy links from link farms.
